ValidationRule.description: Property, Tenant, Rent, Start and End Date are mandatory and End Date must be after Start Date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Property__c), ISBLANK(Tenant__c), ISBLANK(Agreed_Monthly_Rent__c), ISBLANK(Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(End_Date__c), End_Date__c <= Start_Date__c )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Property, Tenant, Agreed Monthly Rent, Start Date and End Date are required, and End Date must be after Start Date.
